source.original_question:
As shown in the figure, then the slope distance between two adjacent trees is ()
Choices:
A:5m
B:6m
C:7m
D:8m

adaptations.reason: Source omits a slope/rise condition, so its answer5 cannot be established from two labels4 alone. Added the explicit 3m vertical rise for one sloped interval; preserved the tree-spacing problem and original answer.

independent_solution.method: The sloping interval is the hypotenuse of a right triangle with legs4 and3, so length=sqrt(4²+3²)=5m.
